text:
Sam: Heads-up — Concordance (prospect) asked for a throughput PoC. They want sustained 400 qps per region for gen requests (avg ~350 tokens, max 512) with p95 < 120ms and a short cold-start profile. Also need a rough price estimate for Dedicated capacity + encryption (KMS) option. Can we run this next week?

Priya: +1. Do we know model footprint they want? open model or Redwood-curated? Also which region pair (us-west/us-east)?

Sam: They said "open to recommendations" but prefer a 7B-ish model. Regions: us-west-2 primary, us-east-1 DR. Customer will enable KMS and wants audit logs retained.

Mika: OK. Quick questions: 1) Is estimate for sustained QPS with continuous requests (steady-state) or spiky bursts with 10s microbursts? 2) Are requests single-turn generation or chat with long KV cache (i.e., repeated prefixes)?

Sam: Sustained steady-state for 30m windows, occasional 5s microbursts x10. Single-turn generation (no long-chat context), but many requests reuse the same 64-token prompt header.

Mika: Good — prefix reuse helps a lot with KV caching. Proposed plan:
- Model: rwd-open-7b (quantized recommended)
- Hardware: 2x A10GX per region (dedicated pool) with autoscale + 1 spare node for failover
- Load pattern: ramp to 400 qps over 5m, hold 30m, 10x 5s microbursts spaced across window
- Metrics: p50/p95/p99 latency, GPU util, token/sec, error-rate, cold-start 95th

Mika: Load command (we'll use k6 + custom client):
```
k6 run --vus 400 --duration 40m script.js --env MODEL=rwd-open-7b --env REGION=us-west-2
```
Sample simplified response log:
```
[2026-03-23 15:12:34] req_id=abc123 lat_ms=68 status=200 tokens_out=340
[2026-03-23 15:12:35] req_id=abc124 lat_ms=95 status=200 tokens_out=348
p95=118ms p99=210ms
```

Priya: Nice. A few ops/security asks: KMS will add ~4-12ms auth overhead per request? Do we include that in SLA target? Customer insists end-to-end (post-auth) p95 < 120ms. Also need to confirm whether we can surface per-request audit logs in Console for them.

Mika: KMS overhead depends on where envelope/key ops run. If using regional KMS (same AZ) it's closer to 4-6ms. We'll include KMS overhead in the test by enabling customer-simulated KMS calls on the path. Console already supports per-request metadata with redaction — can enable for enterprise trial.

Theo: ops-bot: scheduling note — next available dedicated pool window is Tue 2026-03-31 10:00 PT. Reserving 2x A10GX per region requires a 48h heads-up for infra allocation. Shall I tentatively book?

Sam: Tentative book yes. Also need pricing ask: Concordance wants monthly committed price for dedicated pool that meets this throughput with 99.9% uptime SLA. Can you ballpark hourly cost for what Mika proposed?

Mika: Quick back-of-envelope: 2x A10GX equiv (per region) ~ $X/hr per region for dedicated capacity (including infra + support). For both regions and spare node roughly 3x X/hr. With typical usage patterns and amortized support, ballpark $Y/day -> $Z/month for a 12-month commit. I can compute exact numbers after we pick model quant/profile.

Priya: Also flagging enterprise blocker: Concordance requires that Dedicated run inside their VPC for compliance. That changes networking, egress, and potentially latency. We should include a note that private deployment may increase setup lead time by 2-3 weeks and could change price.

Mika: Agree. Private/VPC option: added network hops (VPN/Direct Connect) and customer-managed KMS might add +10-25ms depending on topology. We should run two variants in PoC: hosted-dedicated with managed KMS and a private-VPC smoke to measure delta.

Sam: Good call. For the PoC deliverables I'll propose: 1) perf run report (p50/p95/p99, throughput curve), 2) cost estimate for hosted-dedicated vs private-VPC, 3) list of blockers with mitigations, 4) short video of tail latency behavior.

Priya: I'll start the security questionnaire answers and pull the KMS contact. @Mika can you draft the runbook / commands and an expected metrics dashboard snapshot we can share?

Mika: Will do. Draft runbook snippets below — will post full doc in GH once we lock schedule.
```
# runbook excerpt
1) Reserve infra: 2x A10GX (us-west-2), 2x A10GX (us-east-1), 1 spare each
2) Deploy model: rwd-open-7b quant profile q8_256
3) Start k6 workers, ensure prefix caching enabled
4) Validate warmup: hit 50 qps for 10m
5) Ramp to 400 qps over 5m, hold 30m
6) Record perf, enable per-request logs
```

Theo: ops-bot: confirmed tentative reservation for Tue 2026-03-31 10:00 PT. Infra team notified. Please confirm by EOD Thu 2026-03-26 to avoid release conflicts.

Sam: I'll confirm with Concordance and get back. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

Priya: One more — pricing team needs an explicit list of the hardware SKU and expected token/sec to compute spot vs reserved pricing. Mika can you include tokens/sec estimate in the report?

Mika: Yep. Expect ~120k tokens/sec aggregate per region at 400 qps with avg 300 tokens. I'll include exact numbers and a contingency plan (quantized model fallback) in the writeup.
